title: 第15章 你是魔吗第16章 魔骨打狗棒
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
大佛禅寺的经纶一盏盏被点亮，
经音飘荡在三江流域，
让人格外心安，
偶尔响起嘹亮浩荡的佛钟驱妖除魔，
同时也警示着世人，世间并不太平，
也警示妖魔鬼怪，
作恶必将受到大佛的无边佛掌灭杀！
云阳接了任务后便在三江游历，
不知不觉来到望江亭，
望江亭下面三江汇聚的江水涛涛向前，波浪汹涌翻滚，
三江流域尽收眼底，
平原一望无垠燃起袅袅炊烟，
入门在农田辛勤的栽种农作物，
微风吹过，
卷起一片片金色稻浪，
天际线，
是与天争高的峨眉，
连绵不绝的青山秀美而神秘，
上面佛道争鸣共存，
数不清的神话传说，

让人禁不住的向往探索。
‘铛·昂·昂昂·’
嘹亮的钟声又在三江流域回荡，
把云阳从万千思绪中拉回，
摸了一把俊秀的脸庞；
‘阿弥托佛，经纶染寒江，佛音正浩荡，心如有菩提，何愁不光明，
怎么就下雨了？’
‘喂，想什么呢，本仙子就在你面前，还想什么想入非非呢，跟你说话都不回，’
云阳看了面前这个叽叽喳喳，漂亮的跟瓷娃娃一样的小魔女眉头一皱；
‘阿弥托佛，你还是在凤凰岛时可爱一些。’
说完便沿着江边悬崖的崎岖青石路走去，
其实是少女太闲太枯燥了，
她天生圣女，
不需要怎么努力，修为都会蹭蹭蹭的涨，
自带天赋，出生就有法力。
平时都是在凤族接受万人敬仰，
每天无忧无虑的玩耍，
如今来负责监督截杀这个枯燥无味的和尚，
关键这小和尚还不搭理她，
太岂有此理了，

一步就跨上去扯住云阳的僧袍；
‘废材，跟本仙子说话时，不准念阿弥托佛，否则，哼哼，你懂得，说，为什么老是对本仙子爱理不理，’
云阳不一样，
content_en:
The financial affairs of Dafo Zen Temple are illuminated one by one,
The sound of sutras floats in the Sanjiang River Basin,
Makes you feel extra at ease,
Occasionally, the loud and powerful Buddhist bells are rung to drive away demons,
At the same time, it also warns the world that the world is not peaceful.
Also warns demons and ghosts,
Anyone who does evil will be killed by the boundless palms of the Buddha!
After Yunyang accepted the mission, he traveled around Sanjiang.
Unknowingly, I came to Wangjiang Pavilion,
Below Wangjiang Pavilion, the water of the three rivers converges forward, the waves are turbulent and rolling,
You can have a panoramic view of the Sanjiang River Basin.
The plain stretches as far as the eye can see, with smoke rising from the kitchens.
Start working hard in the farmland planting crops,
The breeze blows,
Rolling up pieces of golden rice waves,
skyline,
It is Emei who competes with the sky,
The endless green mountains are beautiful and mysterious,
Above, Buddhism and Taoism contend and coexist,
Countless myths and legends,
It makes people want to explore.
‘Dang·ang·angang·’
The loud bells echoed in the Sanjiang Basin again,
Pull Yunyang away from thousands of thoughts,
Touched his handsome face;
'Amitabha, the scriptures are dyed in the cold river, the Buddha's voice is majestic, and the heart is like Bodhi, why worry about not being bright?
Why did it rain? ’
'Hey, what are you thinking about? This fairy is right in front of you. What else are you thinking about? I won't even reply when I talk to you.'
Yunyang frowned when he looked at the chirping little witch in front of him, who was as beautiful as a porcelain doll;
‘Amitofu, you are still cuter when you were on Phoenix Island. ’
After saying that, he walked along the rugged bluestone road along the cliff by the river.
In fact, girls are too idle and boring.
She was born a saint,
No matter how hard you work, your cultivation level will rise slowly.
He has his own talent and is born with magic power.
Usually he is admired by thousands of people in the Feng Clan,
Play carefree every day,
Now I am responsible for supervising the interception and killing of this boring monk.
The key is that this little monk still doesn't pay attention to her.
This is so unreasonable,
In one step, he stepped forward and grabbed Yunyang's monk's robe;
'Good-for-nothing, when talking to this fairy, you are not allowed to recite Amitabha, otherwise, hum, you know, why do you always ignore this fairy?'
Yunyang is different,
